images.prompt:
Documentary photograph, medium format, natural colour, subtle film grain, soft early-morning alpenglow light (pale rose and violet in the sky, warm light on the land, clear air, light haze in the distance). A real Swiss landscape dominates the frame (about two thirds): mountains, lake, meadows, forest or river. Human-made structures are small, calm and well made: pale ceramic, light timber, glass, low and integrated into the terrain. Technology is mature and quiet: matte white, rounded, functional, never the subject of the picture. Few people, small in the frame, natural and unposed, seen from a distance, behind or in profile, no recognisable faces. One small accent of warm rose or violet. Wide composition, high horizon, a sense of order and calm. No text, no logos, no flags, no signage, no screens or holograms, no neon, no chrome, no spaceships or flying vehicles, no crowds, no dystopia, no glossy CGI look.

A low, discreet compute building with a timber and glass façade set into a hillside above a reservoir lake, warm air vents feeding a greenhouse next to it; mountains and a hydroelectric dam in the distance.
